$comment: Rhythm / position rules beyond JSON Schema. Every rule id here is implemented under the same id in schema/semantic_validate.py RULES (verify_all.py checks the two sets are identical and severities agree).

rules.description: nodes must be an in-order subsequence of the declared template's node list, contain every required:true node, and contain no node absent from that template.
route must be one of the declared template's routes.
chrome.site-nav must be the first node.
chrome.site-footer must be the last node.
conversion.start-today-cta must sit immediately before chrome.site-footer.
exactly one hero.intro, immediately after chrome.site-nav.
rules.exception: None needed: the only template has a hero.

rules.description: no section appears twice (every template node is repeatable:false; no section has variants, so the key is the section id).
proof.logo-marquee, hero.wordmark-stage and hero.product-demo may only appear before every NARRATIVE/SHOWCASE/proof.why-tines node (they belong to the hero region).
two adjacent nodes of the same category are flagged.
rules.exceptionNote: Both pairs are adjacent on the real homepage.

rules.description: every assetRole used in a node must list that node's section in assets/asset-roles.json allowedSections.
every node's motion.reducedMotionFallback must equal its section contract's const fallback.
every string with a schema maxWords budget must not exceed it (words = whitespace-separated tokens).
